subject: AWS marketplace: fulfillment evidence request, entitlement mapping & billing handoff
messages:
From: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmecloud.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 25 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AWS Marketplace fulfillment evidence + billing handoff

Hi Soojin,

We're finalizing the SOW and procurement checklist for Acme Analytics (purchase order to follow). AWS procurement needs a small packet from Redwood so Marketplace listing & metering can go live:

- Evidence of entitlement mapping (how Redwood will map Acme tenant IDs to metering records)
- Webhook sample payload for usage events and retry semantics
- Expected lag from event -> usage ingestion -> invoiceable units (P50/P95)
- Security attestation: where logs are stored and retention window

Can you share a short packet we can attach to the procurement file? We need it by EOD PT next Tuesday (2025-09-30) to keep the go-live target.

Thanks,
Susan
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme CloudOps

Attachment: PO_template.docx (referenced)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmecloud.com>, procure@acmecloud.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Marketplace fulfillment evidence + billing handoff

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear list.

I can pull together the entitlement mapping and webhook spec. Attaching a draft entitlement matrix and a metering webhook spec for your review (see attached). Highlights:

- Entitlement mapping: Redwood will emit marketplace entitlement IDs as a 1:1 mapping to Acme tenant UUIDs (we include both tenant_id and marketplace_subscription_id in the usage payload). Policy options include seat-based vs consumption-based granularity; I've put our recommended mapping in the matrix.
- Webhook: payload example + idempotency key and retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter, up to 24 hours).
- Lag: typical P50 ingestion -> billing-ready is ~18s for small batches, P95 under 3m for production traffic. We'll include the observability hooks for longer tails (tracing ids).
- Logs/retention: usage events retained in customer-specific logs for 90 days; aggregated billing records retained for 2 years.

Next steps:
1) Ben — can you confirm the mapping for the usage_unit calculation (token units vs session-minutes) and whether we'll expose both raw_tokens and normalized_units in the webhook?
2) Karthik — can you coordinate with Marketplace enablement on the DocuSign flow and any required marketplace contract clauses?

I'll assemble a one-page packet for procurement and circulate.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SaaS_Entitlement_Matrix_v1.xlsx; Metering_Webhook_Spec.md

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Sep 2025 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Marketplace fulfillment evidence + billing handoff

On Thu, Sep 25, 2025 at 10:05 AM soojin_lee@redwood.ai wrote:
> I'll assemble a one-page packet for procurement and circulate.

Quick note on units mapping:
- For Acme's workload we recommend using normalized_units based on token-equivalent compute: 1 normalized_unit = 1K prompt+completion tokens (configurable).
- We'll include raw_token_count in the webhook so Acme can validate volumes and tie back to internal metrics.
- Metering computation will run in our ingestion pipeline; we'll include a deterministic formula in the webhook spec to avoid reconciliation drift.

If Procurement prefers seat-pricing for a portion of the subscription, we can emit an "entitlement_type" field and a separate seat_count webhook event.

I reviewed the matrix and added a few example rows (see updated spreadsheet).

– Ben
Principal Engineer, Billing Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SaaS_Entitlement_Matrix_v1.xlsx (updated)

From: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Sep 2025 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Analytics — Marketplace listing enablement (next steps)

Hi team,

Thanks for the packet. A couple of items to complete certification on our side:
1) DocuSign route: we need the finalized marketplace addendum signed by Acme. I've generated the DocuSign envelope and shared a link below. Please confirm which internal Redwood signatory should be applied.
2) Evidence: please include the webhook sample (JSON) with a real example event (no PII) and a short note on idempotency headers used.
3) Metering reconciliation: will Redwood provide a daily usage CSV for Acme + a reconciliation endpoint that returns usage deltas for a given invoice period? This is required for our settlement process.

DocuSign (unsigned): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/signed/ACME-RWF-2381

Let me know if you'd like a 30 min sync with Marketplace enablement next week.

Regards,
Priya Menon
AWS Marketplace Enablement

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmecloud.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace: fulfillment evidence request, entitlement mapping & billing handoff

Susan / Priya — thanks for the quick turn. Final updates and plan below (sending updated attachments).

Summary of deliverables (attached):
- Redwood_SaaS_Entitlement_Matrix_v2.xlsx: final mapping (tenant_uuid <-> marketplace_subscription_id), entitlement_type, pricing_unit, and reconciliation keys.
- Metering_Webhook_Spec.md: includes production sample payload, idempotency header (X-Redwood-Idempotency), retry window, and an example daily usage CSV header for reconciliation.
- SOW signed by Acme (attached copy).

Operational commitments:
- Daily reconciliation CSV pushed to Acme S3 bucket (or via secure transfer) by 03:00 UTC for the prior UTC day. File includes per-subscription normalized_units and raw_token_count.
- Reconciliation endpoint: /reconciliation/v1/deltas?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD (auth via customer API key). We'll return delta rows and a checksum.
- Support SLA: 24h response for billing disputes; 72h for reconciliations requiring data pulls.

Next steps / owners:
- Karthik: accept the DocuSign envelope as Redwood counterparty (I'll assign you as signee unless you prefer Marissa).
- Marissa: confirm S3 transfer details and who will approve the ACL.
- Ben: we'll hand-off instrumentation and the deterministic unit formula to Acme's finance contact (Susan).

Scheduling: propose a 30-min handoff call Friday 2025-10-03 10:00 PT to validate the reconciliation CSV format and finalize ACLs. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SaaS_Entitlement_Matrix_v2.xlsx; Metering_Webhook_Spec.md; Acme_Signed_SOW.pdf
